faults.stored: Article 1 of the 2017 statute (Official Gazette text) gives the museum legal personality with financial and administrative independence under a statute approved by the Supreme Leader, with a board of trustees chaired by the Chief of the Armed Forces General Staff; the 2021 amendment, which gives Tehran Municipality the duty to provide budget and staff, is in force.
faults.page says: Both cited pages are edalatsara.com, a law-information site that reprints the statute and the 2021 amendment under the Presidential Office covering letters asking for Official Gazette publication; neither page is the Official Gazette, and neither shows the amendment is still in force today.
faults.fix: Article 1 of the 2017 statute, as reproduced on edalatsara.com, gives the museum legal personality with financial and administrative independence under a statute approved by the Supreme Leader, with a board of trustees chaired by the Chief of the Armed Forces General Staff; the 2021 amendment, reproduced on the same site, gives Tehran Municipality the duty to provide budget and staff.
